items.title: Samvardhana Motherson Realigns Target Deadlines for Three Global Acquisitions
items.summary: Global automotive components manufacturer Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has adjusted the expected completion timelines for three separate international acquisitions, according to regulatory disclosures filed on Tuesday. The updates modify the closing schedules for corporate transactions across its operations in Japan, Europe, and South Africa.

items.title: Carmakers pare discounts as GST cut revives small-car demand
items.summary: Maruti Suzuki and Tata Motors have significantly lowered or removed incentives on popular models like the Wagon R, Baleno, Tiago, and Punch. This shift reflects renewed confidence in affordable vehicles, with sales of smaller cars showing a substantial uptick.

items.title: Lumax Auto Technologies Consolidates Ownership in Joint Venture Subsidiary Lumax FAE Technologies
items.summary: Automotive component manufacturer Lumax Auto Technologies Limited has completed the acquisition of the remaining 15.97 percent equity stake in its joint venture subsidiary, Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited. The transactions were concluded on Monday following an initial regulatory intimation filed by the company on May 29, 2026.

items.title: Heavy Industries Ministry Extends Global Tender Deadline for Rare Earth Magnet Manufacturing Scheme
items.summary: The Ministry of Heavy Industries has extended the bid submission timeline for its global tender under the Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnet. Following requests from multiple industry stakeholders, the bid due date has been moved from June 29 to July 29, 2026.

items.title: PLI, duty incentives soon for lithium, nickel processing units in India
items.summary: This strategic move aims to reduce reliance on overseas processors and bolster the nation's critical minerals ecosystem. The initiative supports the National Critical Minerals Mission and aligns with projected growth in demand for electric vehicle batteries.
